verdict.rationale: Unleash's impact-metrics docs describe safeguards that watch metrics during a rollout. When a threshold is crossed, they automatically pause the rollout or disable the environment, and they can pull external metrics from Prometheus or VictoriaMetrics. This covers metric-guarded detection plus an automatic kill or rollback action. missing for 10: detailed docs on how the safeguard is configured and how the rollback works (it is described as disabling an environment, not reverting to a prior milestone), and independent or hands-on corroboration that automatic rollback works in practice.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can guard a rollout with metrics so a regression is detected and the release is rolled back automatically

citations.quote: Automate milestone progression or trigger safeguards that pause rollouts or disable environments when metrics cross a threshold.
Pause automatically when request latency increases during a rollout.
Progress from 25% to 50% only if error rates stay below a threshold.
External metrics are queried at read time from your existing Prometheus or VictoriaMetrics instance.
you can define a reusable, structured rollout process that progresses automatically while monitoring application health
